newsitem.title: UK: IPE oil futures close 77 higher in late scramble.
newsitem.headline: IPE oil futures close 77 higher in late scramble.

text.p: IPE crude oil futures closed 77 cents higher on Friday as a late short-covering scramble reversed the week's earlier gains but dealers said the move was in low volume and did not imply an upward trend was in place.
December Brent closed the week at $22.98 a barrel, up 77 cents after reaching an intra-day high of $23.00 a barrel in the last few minutes of trade.
"Its breaking up on Friday night when there are not enough people to stop it. There is very little selling around and it broke a few important numbers," a broker said.
"We tend to view a break as something that has volume with it," he added.
In New York, Dec WTI closed 81 cents up at $23.55 a barrel.
The broker said WTI would have had to go above $23.70 a barrel to catch up with Brent.
IPE gas oil tracked stronger NYMEX heating oil with a forecast for cold weather in the key U.S. Northeast market providing support ahead of the weekend.
IPE gas oil closed up $1.00 a tonne at $222 with dealers seeing scope for further increases ahead of the contract's expiry on Tuesday.

Forecasts of rising oil demand in the final quarter of this year by the International Energy Agency were shrugged off by the market, brokers said production was also set to rise, helping to alleviate the acute stock shortages.
